Synopsis:
    A British man (Joshua Cammidge, 31) appeared in London court charged with providing Russian military intelligence (GRU) with locations of UK drone manufacturing facilities near Swindon and offering to sabotage them. The case is part of a broader pattern of escalating Russian hybrid warfare activity across Europe, including alleged drone attacks in Germany and embassy infiltration in Moscow. UK officials are publicly warning of intensifying Russian espionage and sabotage campaigns targeting Ukraine's allies. The broader context includes Russia threatening to strike British military targets and European nations flagging a step-up in Russian hybrid operations.

Q02. Is the content confirming already known information or reporting very new/uncertain risks?
Risk score: 30 — Russian hybrid warfare and GRU sabotage operations against Western nations have been a well-documented and widely flagged threat since 2022. This case adds a specific data point but confirms an established pattern rather than revealing a novel or unexpected risk vector.
